user.title: Find your bin nights
user.description: Enter your full Guernsey postcode to find your address. No account or address ID is needed.

data_description.postcode: For example, GY1 1AA. Spaces and capital letters are optional.

address.title: Choose your address
address.description: Select your address in {postcode}. Collection dates come from the States of Guernsey's My Bin Night service.

error.invalid_postcode: Enter a full Guernsey postcode, such as GY1 1AA.
error.no_addresses: No addresses were found. Check your postcode and try again.
error.too_many_results: The collection service returned an incomplete address list. Check that you entered your full postcode and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the States of Guernsey's bin collection service. Please try again.
error.invalid_response: The collection service returned an unexpected response. Please try again later.
error.invalid_address: Select an address from the list.
error.address_not_found: This address is no longer available. Restart setup to search again.

init.title: Collection updates
init.description: Choose how often to check the collection service for schedule changes. Once every 24 hours is recommended. Sensors also advance automatically at midnight.
